name: factory-b1-v1
reason: Fixed four groups for a descriptive sensitivity run with 126 train projects. Neither parameter is attributed to the author. No selection by validation or test accuracy.
missing: Require all eight fields in this particular complete snapshot; fail on missing.
price_scope: exact major_category 結構體工程, synthetic amount sum; B1 site_area, B2 total_floor_area. Same groups and estimation procedure; recompute bandwidth after changing units.
quantity_scope: SYN-CONCRETE and SYN-REBAR, MaterialOnly, exact tuple of material_code, spec, unit and price_scope; floor area. Synthetic spec identifies scenario, not engineering grade.
split: Fit only train. Report validation and test separately. Exclude FAC-20261122-SC-0052 from primary test. Retrospective selection may use newer historical projects.
bandwidth: same scalar probe 4096 grid, bisect [1e-4,1], tol 1e-8; cache per cluster/scope
threshold: No review threshold evaluated; coverage and relative interval score descriptive only.
extremes: Keep positive finite observations, fail on nonpositive target or nonfinite, zero span abstains.
summary: Report per split, scope and level; no model selection or cross-method adoption decision.
